fuel_l_per_100km.note: Average on-road fuel economy of US box trucks: 9.05 mpg (2021). 235.2 / 9.05 mpg = 26.0 L/100 km. Single rate for loaded and empty running.
fuel_l_per_100km.source: U.S. DOE Vehicle Technologies Office, Fact of the Week #1342 (May 13, 2024), dataset 'Average On-Road Fuel Economy by Truck Body Type, 2021', from the 2021 Vehicle Inventory and Use Survey (BTS/Census)

co2_kg_per_l.note: Diesel fuel 10.21 kg CO2 per gallon; 10.21 / 3.785 L per gal = 2.697 kg/L. Combustion only (tank-to-wheel), no upstream emissions.
co2_kg_per_l.source: U.S. EPA, GHG Emission Factors Hub 2025, Table 2 (Mobile Combustion CO2), last modified 15 January 2025

fuel_price_usd_per_l.note: US average on-highway diesel retail price $5.937/gal for the week of 2026-11-16; 5.937 / 3.785 L per gal = $1.57/L.
fuel_price_usd_per_l.source: U.S. EIA, Gasoline and Diesel Fuel Update, U.S. On-Highway Diesel Fuel Prices (released 2026-11-17)

max_detour_km.note: Extra distance the carrier's truck may add to pick up a shared load
